name: open_account
description: Submit an account application or service enrollment at Trinity Reserve Bank. Use this when a user wants to open an account (checking, savings, IRA) or enroll in a service (managed investing, private client). This is a synthetic demonstration intake — never request a real Social Security number, full account number, or other sensitive credential.

products.description: List of products or services to apply for or enroll in

name.description: Name of the product or service (e.g., 'Everyday Checking', 'High-Yield Savings', 'Roth IRA')

quantity.description: Number of accounts of this type to open

options.description: Any options or preferences (e.g., 'joint account', 'paperless statements')

applicant_name.description: Name of the applicant submitting the application
